full_details: You heard the Cross and did not go down. Wheat, if they were still honest, was still six-and-thirty. In the afternoon Susanna stood on a stool and read the girl. Hamnet read the boy at a gallop and stopped at the wings to ask for a ladder or a friend. Judith was the Nurse, Madam in three sizes, and she was also the moon, with a candle. You laughed, and it hurt, and you laughed. Susanna said the girl is too quick to say yes. You changed nothing. Anne asked if this was the work, and she thought better of it than she had. On the tables you wrote the two lines, and you did not write Susanna an answer.
one_sentence: You stayed on the floor through market day, and the children played the orchard scene at the bedside until Susanna said the girl is too quick.
title: She is too quick to say yes
